spans.s:
छत्त्र, अस्, m. (often spelt छत्र), a mush-
room; N. of a kind of grass, = भू-तृण; a bee-
hive of a conical or umbrella form; (आ), f., N. of
several plants, viz. Anethum Sowa; also = अति-
च्छत्त्र; coriander; N. of a plant supposed to
grow in Kaśmīra; the plant Rubia Munjista; a
mushroom; (अम्), n. a parasol, an umbrella, called
Chattar by the natives, and regarded as an ensign of
royal or delegated power; N. of a constellation;
concealing the faults of a teacher (this meaning is
invented for the explanation of the word छात्त्र);
[cf. अति-च्छत्र, आकृति-च्छत्त्रा, गोमय-च्छ्˚.]
—छत्त्र-गुच्छ, अस्, m. the grass Scirpus Kysoor
(कशेरु), = गुण्ड-तृण.
—छत्त्र-गृह, अम्, n.
the room in which the parasol (or badge of royalty)
is kept.
—छत्त्र-चक्र, अम्, n. an astrological
diagram.
—छत्त्र-धार, अस्, ई, अम्, bearing a
parasol or umbrella, having or possessing one; (अस्),
m. the bearer of a parasol.
—छत्त्र-धारण,
अम्, n. carrying or using a parasol or umbrella;
carrying one as a type of royal authority.
—छत्त्र-
धार-त्व, अम्, n. the office of a parasol-bearer.
—छत्त्र-धारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, = छत्र-धार above;
(ई), m., N. of a son of Horila-siṃha.
—छत्त्र-
पति, इस्, or sometimes छत्त्र-प, अस्, m. ‘lord of
the umbrella or parasol,’ title of an ancient king in
Jambu-dvīpa, or of any king over whom a parasol
is carried as a mark of dignity, (whence the title
Satrap is probably derived.)
—छत्त्र-पत्त्र, अम्,
n., N. of the plant Ketmia Mutabilis.
—छत्त्र-
पुष्पक, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = तिलक.
—छत्-
त्र-भङ्ग, अस्, m. breaking or destruction of the
royal parasol, loss of dominion or empire, deposition,
&c.; wilfulness, independence; a forlorn condition,
widowhood.
—छत्त्र-युक्ति, इस्, f. a chapter in king
Bhoja's work called Yukti-kalpa-taru.
—छत्त्र-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, furnished with an umbrella; (ती), f., N.
of a country or town.
—छत्त्रातिच्छत्त्र (˚र-अत्˚),
अस्, आ, m. f. a fragrant grass described as growing
in marshy ground, = छत्त्रक and अति-च्छत्त्रा.
—छत्त्रा-धान्य, अम्, n. coriander.

छात्त्र, अस्, m. a pupil, scholar, disciple, tyro,
novice, (as carrying his teacher's umbrella or as con-
cealing his faults ?); (अम्), n. a kind of honey.
—छात्त्र-गण्ड, अस्, m. an indifferent poetical
scholar knowing only the beginnings of verses.
—छात्त्र-गोमिन्, ई, इनी, इ, any one attendant on a
pupil.
—छात्त्र-ता, f. condition of a pupil, pupilage.
—छात्त्र-दर्शन, अम्, n. fresh butter prepared
from milk one day old (‘looked at by the pupils’).
—छात्त्र-व्यंसक, अस्, m. a knavish or roguish
pupil.

छत्त्रक, अस्, m. a temple in honour of Śiva of
a spherical or umbrella shape; a beehive of a conical
form; the plant Asteracantha Longifolia; a mush-
room; a kingfisher; (इका), f. a mushroom.

छत्त्राक, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = जाल-वर्वू-
रक; (ई), f., N. of a plant, = रास्ना; (अम्), n. a
mushroom.
छात्त्रक, अम्, n. honey in the comb or hive.
छत्त्रिक, अस्, m. the bearer of a parasol.
छत्त्रिण, अस्, m., N. of a man.

छत्त्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, bearing or having a parasol or
umbrella, belonging to one; (ई), m. a barber.

छत्त्वर, अस्, m. a house, a dwelling; a bower,
an arbour.
छात्त्रिक्य, अम्, n. the office of a parasol-bearer.

छात or छित, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, divided, thin,
feeble, emaciated.
